entities.name: Kaza
entities.description: A human thrill seeker and master wizard of Zendikar, member of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, who specializes in explosions.

entities.name: Sea Gate Expeditionary House
entities.description: Zendikari expeditionary house Kaza belongs to.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: Kaza's teammate who located her with Jace's help.

entities.name: Zareth San
entities.description: Kaza's teammate who saved her from an elemental attack.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker who hired the party, later compleated by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Linvala
entities.description: Angel who fought with the party against Nahiri.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: Commander who sent the party to Emeria.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who helped Akiri find Kaza and Orah.

entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: Skyclave where the Lithoform Core was found.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: Place where the party fought compleated Nahiri.

events.summary: After the Eldrazi are defeated, Nahiri hires Kaza and her friends to go to the Murasa Skyclave for the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: Kaza and her three friends were hired by Nahiri to accompany her to the Murasa Skyclave

events.summary: Elementals attack and separate Kaza and Orah from the party; Akiri later finds them with Jace's help.
events.quote: Akiri later located them with the help of Jace Beleren

events.summary: Tazri sends Akiri, Linvala, Kaza and Orah to Emeria, where they see compleated Nahiri return.
events.quote: where they witnessed the return of the compleated Nahiri

events.summary: The party fights Nahiri and breaks her from the Hedron network; the Skyclave crashes with her inside.
events.quote: the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

relations.quote: She is a member of the Sea Gate Expeditionary House
